    Standard library only (it runs on any runner with Python 3.9+). `aap pipelines export` inlines this file into every
    shipped workflow, so approving a workflow's commit SHA (config/trusted-producers.yaml) also approves this code.

        aap_evidence.py manifest --type scan.sast --tool-name codeql --tool-version 2.20.1 \\
            --out "$RUNNER_TEMP/evidence" results.sarif

    attestation, and re-hashes every file. Upload the output directory as the artifact `aap-evidence-<name>`.

    import hashlib
    import json
    import os
    import re
    import shutil
    import sys
    from datetime import datetime, timezone
    from pathlib import Path

    SCHEMA_VERSION = "1.0"
    PREDICATE_TYPE = "https://fortproof.dev/attestation/evidence/v1"
    MANIFEST = "evidence-manifest.json"
    MAX_FILES = 50
    MAX_FILE_BYTES = 200 * 1024 * 1024
    EVIDENCE_TYPES = (
        "scan.sast", "scan.sca", "scan.secrets", "scan.iac", "scan.container", "sbom", "provenance.attestation",
        "scan.malicious_package", "scan.workflow_hardening", "test.security", "scan.dast", "scan.api", "deploy.record",
    )
    RESULTS = ("pass", "fail", "findings", "inconclusive", "error")
    MEDIA_TYPES = {
        ".sarif": "application/sarif+json",
        ".cdx.json": "application/vnd.cyclonedx+json",
        ".spdx.json": "application/spdx+json",
        ".json": "application/json",
        ".xml": "application/xml",
        ".txt": "text/plain",
        ".log": "text/plain",
    }
    SAFE_NAME = re.compile(r"^[A-Za-z0-9._-]+$")


    class EvidenceError(Exception):
        pass

    def _need(env: dict, name: str) -> str:
        value = env.get(name)
        if not value:
            raise EvidenceError(f"{name} is not set: run this inside the CI job that produced the files")
        return value


    def _event(env: dict) -> dict:
        path = env.get("GITHUB_EVENT_PATH")
        if not path or not Path(path).is_file():
            return {}
        try:
            return json.loads(Path(path).read_text())
        except ValueError:
            return {}

        pr = event.get("pull_request") or {}
        # On pull_request events GITHUB_SHA is the temporary merge commit; the run's head_sha (what the platform binds
        # to) is the PR head.
        commit = (pr.get("head") or {}).get("sha") or _need(env, "GITHUB_SHA")
        runner = env.get("RUNNER_ENVIRONMENT", "github-hosted")
        ctx = {
            "repository": {
                "full_name": _need(env, "GITHUB_REPOSITORY"),
                "id": int(_need(env, "GITHUB_REPOSITORY_ID")),
            },
            "commit_sha": commit,
            "ref": _need(env, "GITHUB_REF"),
            "pull_request": pr.get("number"),
            "run": {
                "id": int(_need(env, "GITHUB_RUN_ID")),
                "attempt": int(env.get("GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT", "1")),
                "workflow_ref": _need(env, "GITHUB_WORKFLOW_REF"),
                "event": _need(env, "GITHUB_EVENT_NAME"),
                "runner_environment": runner if runner in ("github-hosted", "self-hosted") else "self-hosted",
            },
        }
        visibility = (event.get("repository") or {}).get("visibility")
        if visibility in ("public", "private", "internal"):
            ctx["repository"]["visibility"] = visibility
        if env.get("AAP_JOB_WORKFLOW_REF"):
            ctx["run"]["job_workflow_ref"] = env["AAP_JOB_WORKFLOW_REF"]
        return ctx


    def gitlab_context(env: dict) -> dict:
        mr = env.get("CI_MERGE_REQUEST_IID")
        ctx = {
            "repository": {"full_name": _need(env, "CI_PROJECT_PATH"), "id": int(_need(env, "CI_PROJECT_ID"))},
            "commit_sha": _need(env, "CI_COMMIT_SHA"),
            "ref": f"refs/merge-requests/{mr}/head" if mr else f"refs/heads/{_need(env, 'CI_COMMIT_REF_NAME')}",
            "pull_request": int(mr) if mr else None,
            "run": {
                # the platform binds to the job (it downloads this job's artifacts); the pipeline id is in workflow_ref
                "id": int(_need(env, "CI_JOB_ID")),
                "attempt": 1,
                "workflow_ref": f"{env.get('CI_CONFIG_PATH', '.gitlab-ci.yml')}@pipeline/{_need(env, 'CI_PIPELINE_ID')}",
                "event": _need(env, "CI_PIPELINE_SOURCE")[:64],

                "runner_environment": "self-hosted",

        }

                level = result.get("level", "warning")

                total += 1
        return {"results": total, "by_level": by_level, "driver": driver.get("name"), "driver_version":
                driver.get("semanticVersion") or driver.get("version")}

    def build_manifest(args: argparse.Namespace, env: dict, now: datetime | None = None) -> dict:
        if args.type not in EVIDENCE_TYPES:
            raise EvidenceError(f"--type must be one of {', '.join(EVIDENCE_TYPES)}")
        paths = [Path(p) for p in args.files]
        if not paths:
            raise EvidenceError("give at least one evidence file")
        if len(paths) > MAX_FILES:
            raise EvidenceError(f"at most {MAX_FILES} files")
        out = Path(args.out)
        if out.exists() and any(out.iterdir()):
            raise EvidenceError(f"{out} is not empty: use a fresh directory per evidence bundle")
        out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

        files, summary, sarif_found = [], {}, False
        tool_version = args.tool_version
        for p in paths:
            if not p.is_file():
                raise EvidenceError(f"{p}: not a file")
            if p.stat().st_size > MAX_FILE_BYTES:
                raise EvidenceError(f"{p}: larger than {MAX_FILE_BYTES} bytes")
            if not SAFE_NAME.match(p.name) or p.name == MANIFEST:
                raise EvidenceError(f"{p.name}: file names may use only letters, digits, '.', '_' and '-'")
            if any(f["path"] == p.name for f in files):
                raise EvidenceError(f"{p.name}: two files with the same name")
            mt = media_type(p.name)
            if mt == "application/sarif+json":
                s = sarif_summary(p)
                sarif_found = True

                for level, n in s["by_level"].items():
                    summary.setdefault("by_level", {})[level] = summary.get("by_level", {}).get(level, 0) + n
                tool_version = tool_version or s["driver_version"]
            shutil.copyfile(p, out / p.name)
            files.append({"path": p.name, "sha256": sha256_file(out / p.name), "media_type": mt,
                          "size_bytes": (out / p.name).stat().st_size})
        if not tool_version:
            raise EvidenceError("--tool-version is required (it could not be read from a SARIF file)")

            result = ("findings" if summary.get("results") else "pass") if sarif_found else "pass"
        if result not in RESULTS:
            raise EvidenceError(f"--result must be auto or one of {', '.join(RESULTS)}")

            "schema_version": SCHEMA_VERSION,
            "predicate_type": PREDICATE_TYPE,
            "evidence_type": args.type,
            **ci_context(env),
            "tool": {"name": args.tool_name, "version": str(tool_version)[:64]},
            "result": result,
            "summary": summary,
            "files": files,
            "produced_at": (now or datetime.now(timezone.utc)).strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ"),
        }
        if args.policy_ref:
            manifest["tool"]["policy_ref"] = args.policy_ref
        if args.artifact_digest:
            if not re.match(r"^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$", args.artifact_digest):
                raise EvidenceError("--artifact-digest must be sha256:<64 hex>")
            manifest["artifact"] = {"digest": args.artifact_digest}
            if args.artifact_name:
                manifest["artifact"]["name"] = args.artifact_name

            key, sep, raw = item.partition("=")
            if not sep or not re.match(r"^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,40}$", key):
                raise EvidenceError(f"--summary {item!r}: use key=value (lower-case key)")
            try:
                value = json.loads(raw)
            except ValueError:
                value = raw
            manifest["summary"][key] = value
        if args.environment_name or args.target_url:
            manifest["environment"] = {k: v for k, v in (("name", args.environment_name),
                                                         ("target_url", args.target_url)) if v}

        present = {p.name for p in d.iterdir() if p.is_file() and p.name != MANIFEST}
        if set(declared) != present:
            problems.append(f"files present {sorted(present)} differ from files declared {sorted(declared)}")

            if name in present and sha256_file(d / name) != digest:
                problems.append(f"{name}: sha256 mismatch")

        m = sub.add_parser("manifest", help="copy evidence files into a bundle directory and write its manifest")
        m.add_argument("--type", required=True, help="evidence type, e.g. scan.sast, sbom")
        m.add_argument("--tool-name", required=True)
        m.add_argument("--tool-version", help="default: read from the SARIF driver")
        m.add_argument("--policy-ref", help="ruleset / query suite / policy and its version")
        m.add_argument("--result", default="auto", help="auto (from SARIF results) or pass|fail|findings|inconclusive|error")
        m.add_argument("--artifact-digest", help="sha256:<hex> of the image or package the evidence is about")
        m.add_argument("--artifact-name")
        m.add_argument("--summary", action="append", metavar="KEY=VALUE",
                       help="add a summary field (JSON values allowed), e.g. verified=true")
        m.add_argument("--environment-name")
        m.add_argument("--target-url")
        m.add_argument("--out", required=True, help="an empty directory; upload it as artifact aap-evidence-<name>")
        m.add_argument("files", nargs="+")
        v = sub.add_parser("verify", help="re-hash a bundle directory against its manifest")
        v.add_argument("directory")
        args = p.parse_args(argv)
        try:
            if args.cmd == "manifest":
                manifest = build_manifest(args, dict(os.environ if env is None else env))
                print(f"{manifest['evidence_type']}: {len(manifest['files'])} file(s), result {manifest['result']} "
                      f"→ {Path(args.out) / MANIFEST}")
                return 0
            problems = verify(args.directory)
            for problem in problems:
                print(f"error: {problem}", file=sys.stderr)
            return 1 if problems else 0
        except EvidenceError as e:
            print(f"error: {e}", file=sys.stderr)
            return 2


    if __name__ == "__main__":
        sys.exit(main())

                tool_version = tool_version or s["driver_version"]
            shutil.copyfile(p, out / p.name)
            files.append({"path": p.name, "sha256": sha256_file(out / p.name), "media_type": mt,
                          "size_bytes": (out / p.name).stat().st_size})
        if not tool_version:
            raise EvidenceError("--tool-version is required (it could not be read from a SARIF file)")

        result = args.result
        if result == "auto":
            result = ("findings" if summary.get("results") else "pass") if sarif_found else "pass"
        if result not in RESULTS:
            raise EvidenceError(f"--result must be auto or one of {', '.join(RESULTS)}")

        manifest = {
            "schema_version": SCHEMA_VERSION,
            "predicate_type": PREDICATE_TYPE,
            "evidence_type": args.type,
            **ci_context(env),
            "tool": {"name": args.tool_name, "version": str(tool_version)[:64]},
            "result": result,
            "summary": summary,
            "files": files,
            "produced_at": (now or datetime.now(timezone.utc)).strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ"),
        }
        if args.policy_ref:
            manifest["tool"]["policy_ref"] = args.policy_ref
        if args.artifact_digest:
            if not re.match(r"^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$", args.artifact_digest):
                raise EvidenceError("--artifact-digest must be sha256:<64 hex>")
            manifest["artifact"] = {"digest": args.artifact_digest}
            if args.artifact_name:
                manifest["artifact"]["name"] = args.artifact_name
        for item in args.summary or []:
            key, sep, raw = item.partition("=")
            if not sep or not re.match(r"^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,40}$", key):
                raise EvidenceError(f"--summary {item!r}: use key=value (lower-case key)")
            try:
                value = json.loads(raw)
            except ValueError:
                value = raw
            manifest["summary"][key] = value
        if args.environment_name or args.target_url:
            manifest["environment"] = {k: v for k, v in (("name", args.environment_name),
                                                         ("target_url", args.target_url)) if v}
        (out / MANIFEST).write_text(json.dumps(manifest, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n")
        return manifest


    def verify(directory: str) -> list[str]:
        """Local self-check: what the platform will re-check about the files (not the CI binding)."""
        d = Path(directory)
        try:
            manifest = json.loads((d / MANIFEST).read_text())
        except (OSError, ValueError) as e:
            return [f"{MANIFEST}: {e}"]
        problems = [f"missing field {k}" for k in ("schema_version", "evidence_type", "repository", "commit_sha", "ref",
                                                   "run", "tool", "result", "files", "produced_at") if k not in manifest]
        declared = {f["path"]: f["sha256"] for f in manifest.get("files", [])}
        present = {p.name for p in d.iterdir() if p.is_file() and p.name != MANIFEST}
        if set(declared) != present:
            problems.append(f"files present {sorted(present)} differ from files declared {sorted(declared)}")
        for name, digest in declared.items():
            if name in present and sha256_file(d / name) != digest:
                problems.append(f"{name}: sha256 mismatch")
        return problems


    def main(argv: list | None = None, env: dict | None = None) -> int:
        p = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog="aap-evidence", description=__doc__.split("\n\n")[0])
        sub = p.add_subparsers(dest="cmd", required=True)
        m = sub.add_parser("manifest", help="copy evidence files into a bundle directory and write its manifest")
        m.add_argument("--type", required=True, help="evidence type, e.g. scan.sast, sbom")
        m.add_argument("--tool-name", required=True)
        m.add_argument("--tool-version", help="default: read from the SARIF driver")
        m.add_argument("--policy-ref", help="ruleset / query suite / policy and its version")
        m.add_argument("--result", default="auto", help="auto (from SARIF results) or pass|fail|findings|inconclusive|error")
        m.add_argument("--artifact-digest", help="sha256:<hex> of the image or package the evidence is about")
        m.add_argument("--artifact-name")
        m.add_argument("--summary", action="append", metavar="KEY=VALUE",
                       help="add a summary field (JSON values allowed), e.g. verified=true")
        m.add_argument("--environment-name")
        m.add_argument("--target-url")
        m.add_argument("--out", required=True, help="an empty directory; upload it as artifact aap-evidence-<name>")
        m.add_argument("files", nargs="+")
        v = sub.add_parser("verify", help="re-hash a bundle directory against its manifest")
        v.add_argument("directory")
        args = p.parse_args(argv)
        try:
            if args.cmd == "manifest":
                manifest = build_manifest(args, dict(os.environ if env is None else env))
                print(f"{manifest['evidence_type']}: {len(manifest['files'])} file(s), result {manifest['result']} "
                      f"→ {Path(args.out) / MANIFEST}")
                return 0
            problems = verify(args.directory)
            for problem in problems:
                print(f"error: {problem}", file=sys.stderr)
            return 1 if problems else 0
        except EvidenceError as e:
            print(f"error: {e}", file=sys.stderr)
            return 2


    if __name__ == "__main__":
        sys.exit(main())
